whatIs: Strapi is an open source headless CMS built with TypeScript that runs on Node.js. You define your content types with a no-code builder, and it automatically generates REST and GraphQL APIs, with customizable controllers, services and middleware.
It's a good fit when you want a content backend you can modify deeply. You can self-host it or deploy it to Strapi Cloud with the same code.
uses: Managing the blog or catalog of a Next.js site by consuming its API.
Creating an API for a mobile app from content types defined without code.
Adding your own logic to the backend with custom controllers and services.
caveats: The core is MIT, but features like Review Workflows and Audit Logs are in the Enterprise edition, and SSO is either paid separately or included in Enterprise.
If you self-host it, you manage the server, database, updates and backups.
Strapi Cloud has no free plan: the cheapest is Starter, which doesn't include automatic backups.
pricingNote: The Community edition is free and MIT; Strapi Cloud starts at $35 per project per month, and the self-hosted Growth plan starts at $45 per month.
idealFor: Developers who want a customizable headless CMS on Node.js.
